candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement initialized=true so seeding never initializes the contract.
Set initialized to false instead of true after seeding.
Invert the require condition so seeding can never proceed, leaving initialized false.
Change the assignment so ceoAddress is set to the zero address instead of msg.sender.
Delete the assignment statement so ceoAddress is never updated.
Delete the require statement so anyone can call DrugDealer and set ceoAddress to msg.sender.
Invert the require condition so the CEO cannot call DrugDealer, but any other caller can set ceoAddress.
